snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

requirements.rule: Manuscript file is DOC, DOCX or RTF (LaTeX is submitted as PDF)
requirements.quote: Manuscript files can be in the following formats: DOC, DOCX, or RTF.

requirements.rule: Full title is at most 250 characters
Abstract is at most 300 words
Text is double-spaced
Continuous line numbers
requirements.quote: Include page numbers and line numbers in the manuscript file.

requirements.rule: Page numbers
requirements.quote: Include page numbers and line numbers in the manuscript file.

requirements.rule: No footnotes
Starts with Abstract, then Introduction
Ends with Acknowledgments, References, then Supporting information captions
Funding goes in the submission form, not the manuscript file
requirements.quote: Do not include it in your manuscript file.

requirements.rule: Competing interests are entered in the submission system
Author contributions (CRediT) are entered in the submission system
Data Availability Statement entered at submission; accession numbers or DOIs also given where the data are mentioned
requirements.quote: Accession numbers or a citation to the DOI should also be provided when the data set is mentioned within the manuscript.

requirements.rule: Vancouver references, numbered in square brackets
Figures are separate files, not inside the manuscript
requirements.quote: Do not include figures in the main manuscript file.

requirements.rule: Figure captions go right after the paragraph where the figure is first cited
requirements.quote: Figure captions must be inserted in the text of the manuscript

requirements.rule: Each table goes right after the paragraph where it is first cited
requirements.quote: Place each table in your manuscript file directly after the paragraph in which it is first cited (read order).

requirements.rule: Supporting information is labeled like "S1 Table"
Supporting information captions are listed at the end of the manuscript
Each supporting information file is under 20 MB
At most 3 heading levels
Corresponding author provides an ORCID iD at submission
Figure files: TIFF or EPS, 300-600 dpi, 789-2250 px wide and at most 2625 px high at 300 dpi, RGB or grayscale, under 10 MB, LZW-compressed TIFF, named Fig1.tif, Fig2.tif ...
